name: staff-code-review
description: Staff-engineer-level code review evaluating architectural alignment, system-level implications, failure modes, performance, scalability, observability, security, and cross-team impact.

interface.shortDescription: Review code changes with staff-level depth
interface.longDescription: Triages the change, builds a codebase research brief, reviews it across seven dimensions (architecture, reliability, security, performance, backward compatibility, conventions, dead code) plus a code adversary, synthesizes, and red-teams the findings before returning or posting a pending GitHub review. Runs sequentially on Codex.
